faqs.a:
(a)
A property owner may file a petition for a hearing on the determination that access
               to the property is denied or insufficient. An appeal shall made by filing a petition
               with the utility manager no later than ten calendar days after receiving notice of
               violation of any provision of
section 102-62
or
102-62.1
of this article.
(b)
A property owner or person responsible for payment of any water service bills may
               file a petition for a hearing on the assessment of fees or charges pursuant to any
               provision of
section 102-62.3
of this article. Any petition seeking a hearing on the assessment of such charges
               or fees shall be filed with utilities manager not later than 30 calendar days after
               having first been billed for said charges or fees.
(c)
Except for unavoidable delay, a petition for a hearing not timely filed shall foreclose
               further review by the utilities manager of the determination of lack or denial of
               access or the charges and fees assessed.
(d)
Any petition filed pursuant to this
section 102-62.4
of this article shall be filed in the office of the Utility Manager, City of Arvada
               8101 Ralston Road, Arvada, Colorado 80001. Any such petition shall be in writing and
               shall contain a request for a hearing; the name of the party requesting the hearing
               along with their address and telephone number where the petitioner can be reached
               between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Monday though Friday; and a statement
               describing the basis for the appeal.
(e)
The utility manager may hold a hearing on the petition him or herself, or may designate
               another as the hearing officer with the authority to hold such hearing or hearings.
               The filing of a petition shall not stay payment for any charge during the pendency
               of the hearing. Any petition for a hearing shall be in writing and shall set forth
               with sufficient particularity the reason or reasons for the appeal. Any hearing held
               pursuant to this section shall take place within the city at a date and time set by
               the utility manager, but not earlier than five days nor later than 30 days from the
               date of receipt of the petitions by the utility manager, unless a different time and
               date is agreed to by the petitioner and utility manager. Hearings held pursuant to
               this section shall be held in accordance with the procedures set forth in chapter
               2, article V of this Code.
(
Ord. No. 4030, § 1, 10-16-2006
)
